welcome.title: Appointment scheduling for small teams
welcome.headline: Bookings that respect the working day.
welcome.lede: {{name}} holds your opening hours, your staff, your services and your time off in one place, so every slot you offer is one you can actually keep.

steps.heading: Three steps to your first booking.

setUp.title: Set up your business
setUp.body: Add your services with their duration and buffers, register your staff, and set the hours each person works.

share.title: Share your booking page
share.body: Your customers pick a service, a person and a time from one link. They book without an account: a name and an email or a phone number is enough.

run.title: Run the agenda from one dashboard
run.body: Every appointment lands on the calendar as a full block, and you see the business's day and each staff member's day on the same screen.

benefits.heading: Everything it takes for a free hour to really be free.

team.title: Your staff and your catalogue
team.body: Every service keeps its duration, its buffers and its price, and knows which staff members can deliver it.

hours.title: Weekly hours and time off
hours.body: Set the hours the business opens and the hours each person works, then mark holidays, closures and absences without touching anything else.

slots.title: Times that already count what is taken
slots.body: Every time you offer has been checked against your hours, your time off and everything already booked, with the buffer before and the buffer after included.

policy.title: Your booking rules
policy.body: Each business has its own timezone, its own lead time and its own cut-off date: you decide how soon and how far ahead people may book you.

pricing.heading: Start free. Pay when you work with a team.

free.name: Free
free.summary: For one professional running their own agenda.
